comment: Six parameters are declared and never given a widget: PUSH_PARAM for each of the four channels (indices 12 to 15), CASCADE_TRIGGER_PARAM (18) and an unnamed ENV_FUNC_PARAM (19). The push parameters are read in process() at src/funcgen.cpp:324 but no button is added for them, so no click can reach any of the six and none carries a line or a tag. Eight outputs are likewise declared with no jack: A > C, C > A, B > D, D > B and the four A-C and B-D distance outputs (indices 9, 13, 14, 18, 21, 24, 27 and 30). Four of those eight — A > C, C > A, B > D and D > B — are never written by process() either; the panel only has sections between adjacent channels. CASCADE_LOOP_PARAM is marked TODO IMPLEMENT in the enum at src/funcgen.cpp:24 but is read at lines 348, 545 and 660 and does work. The panel prints almost nothing: Trig All, Min, Max and some waveform glyphs, so nearly every control is named only by its tooltip. Top 2 Average and Bottom 2 Average ignore the range settings and are always built on a 0 to 10V scale, unlike Minimum, Maximum and Average. All eight rise and fall CV jacks carry the maker's second line 'Expects a 0-10V signal' and nothing more.
